kinds.description: The relations a finding can stand for, by kind id, each with the relation the host the finding marks holds, by the name the wire uses for it.

kind_words.description: Per kind id, the words host names habitually carry for it - what the page names to say what it looks for.

relation_titles.description: How each relation reads in a proposed row, by the name the wire uses for it.

relation_nouns.description: What the host at each end of a relation is called, by the name the wire uses for it.

folders.description: The folders the user may see, to narrow the scan to one of them, the main folder first.

folder.description: The folder the page was opened from, by path - where the scan looks unless the user says otherwise.

sites.description: The sites the user may see, to narrow the scan to one of them. Empty where there is only one.
